periods.label: Huge slime-type Abyss used as Belbet's trap

status.condition: ruptured and used to hatch Gargoyle Abyss

appearance.overview: enormous translucent slime-like body with tower-like arms and red-black core deep inside

personality.summary: low-intelligence Abyss that advances steadily and reacts to attacks

mannerisms: ruptures into bubbles under flute influence

background.upbringing: emerges from the southwest ruins and breaks through fortress defenses

belbet-balt.summary: Belbet uses the flute to rupture it and hatch Gargoyles

lisha-atismata.summary: Lisha's Knight Squadron attacks it before its trap effect triggers

sharis-baltshift.summary: Sharis fights as part of the Knight Squadron response

secrets: functions as a God Beast egg under flute control
periods.summary: The large slime-like Abyss is the apparent emergency target outside Crossfield, but it is part of Belbet's trap. It absorbs cannon fire, ruptures, and produces a Gargoyle swarm under flute control.

key_events.summary: Breaches the ruin defense lines and approaches Crossfield.
Ruptures into bubbles that hatch many Gargoyle Abyss under Belbet's flute.
